note: HSK 1 listening in the 新版HSK (2025-12) format, Mainland edition (Simplified, Mainland wording and voices; owner's plan 2026-10-30): 第一部分 听词语选图 ×5, 第二部分 听问题选回答 ×5, 第三部分 听对话选图 (A–F) ×5, 第四部分 听句子回答问题 ×5. Mock exams play each item twice (owner). Original texts. Pictures are described in each set's "pics" and drawn with tools/build_listening_img.py's HSK pass.

panels: three red apples on a plate
a cup of hot tea on a saucer
a closed book lying on a table
a dog sitting and wagging its tail
a cat sitting and licking its paw
a man drinking a glass of water
a boy eating a bowl of rice at a table
a boy talking on a mobile phone
a boy sleeping in bed under a blanket
a doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope
a teacher holding a piece of chalk in front of a completely blank blackboard
a student carrying a school bag
a man sweating under a blazing sun, fanning himself
rain falling on a street, people holding umbrellas
snow covering trees and a house
a woman in a clothes shop holding up a dress, a man next to her smiling
a man getting into a taxi while the driver waits; the small box on the taxi roof is plain and blank, no letters
a student pointing at a drawing of a cat in an open book and asking a teacher in a classroom
a woman talking on the phone at home on a sofa
two friends eating together at a small restaurant table
a sick girl lying in bed with a thermometer, her mother sitting beside her

explain.zh: 聽到的是「蘋果」，A 是盤子上的蘋果。
explain.en: You hear 苹果, apple: A is the plate of apples.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「貓」，B 是坐著舔爪子的貓。
explain.en: You hear 猫, cat: B is the cat.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「睡覺」，C 是在床上睡覺的男孩。
explain.en: You hear 睡觉, to sleep: C is the boy asleep in bed.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「醫生」，A 是穿白袍、戴聽診器的醫生。
explain.en: You hear 医生, doctor: A is the doctor in the white coat.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「下雨」，B 是下雨天撐傘的街道。
explain.en: You hear 下雨, it's raining: B is the rainy street.

explain.zh: 問名字，回答「我叫李明。」
explain.en: He asks your name: "My name is Li Ming."

explain.zh: 問「在哪兒」，回答地點：「在北京。」
explain.en: She asks where: "In Beijing."

explain.zh: 問「幾號」是問日期，回答「十月九號。」；「星期一」是星期幾。
explain.en: 几号 asks the date: "October the ninth." 星期一 would answer "which day of the week".

lines.en: What would you like to drink?

explain.zh: 問想「喝」什麼，回答「我想喝茶。」
explain.en: She asks what you'd like to drink: "I'd like tea."

explain.zh: 問「幾歲」，回答年紀：「她五歲了。」
explain.en: He asks her age: "She's five."

explain.zh: 在店裡問衣服好不好看、要不要買：A。
explain.en: Talking about buying a dress in a shop: A.

explain.zh: 上車告訴司機要去哪裡，是坐計程車：B。
explain.en: Telling the driver where to go — a taxi: B.

lines.en: Teacher, how do you read this character?

explain.zh: 學生問老師字怎麼念：C。
explain.en: A student asks the teacher how to read a character: C.

explain.zh: 「喂」是接電話時說的，在家講電話：D。
explain.en: 喂 is what you say on the phone: the woman on the phone at home, D.

lines.s: 我病了，今天不去学校了。
lines.zh: 我生病了，今天不去學校了。
lines.en: I'm ill; I'm not going to school today.

explain.zh: 「我病了」，躺在床上的生病女孩：F。E（在飯店吃飯）是多出來的。
explain.en: "I'm ill": the sick girl in bed, F. E is the spare picture.

lines.s: 我昨天去商店买了很多水果。
lines.zh: 我昨天去商店買了很多水果。
lines.en: Yesterday I went to the shop and bought lots of fruit.

explain.zh: 「我昨天去商店……」：她去了商店。
explain.en: "Yesterday I went to the shop…"

lines.s: 现在是下午五点，我们六点去吃饭。
lines.zh: 現在是下午五點，我們六點去吃飯。
lines.en: It's five in the afternoon now; we'll go and eat at six.

q.en: What time are they going to eat?

explain.zh: 現在五點，「我們六點去吃飯」。
explain.en: It's five now; "we'll go and eat at six".

lines.s: 我有一个儿子，他今年十岁。
lines.zh: 我有一個兒子，他今年十歲。
lines.en: I have a son; he's ten this year.

explain.zh: 「他今年十歲」。
explain.en: "He's ten this year."

lines.en: It'll rain tomorrow, and it'll be cold.

q.en: What will the weather be like tomorrow?

explain.zh: 「明天下雨，天氣很冷」。
explain.en: "It'll rain tomorrow, and it'll be cold."

lines.s: 我是北京人，现在在上海工作。
lines.zh: 我是北京人，現在在上海工作。
lines.en: I'm from Beijing; now I work in Shanghai.

explain.zh: 她是北京人，可是「現在在上海工作」。
explain.en: She is from Beijing, but "now I work in Shanghai".

panels: an airplane flying in the sky
a taxi waiting on a street; the small box on its roof is plain and blank, no letters anywhere
a laptop computer open on a desk
a wooden chair
a cup with a handle
a small square table
a telephone on a table
a closed book
a television set showing a programme
a girl writing in a notebook with a pencil; the page shows faint wavy lines only, no characters, no letters
a girl reading a book on a bench
a girl drinking a cup of tea
a man in a thick coat shivering in the snow
a man sweating under a blazing sun
a man holding an umbrella in the rain
a man paying the shopkeeper at a shop counter
a girl asking an old man the way on a street, he points ahead
two students reading books together at a library table
a mother handing her child a coat at the front door
a waiter bringing dishes to a table in a restaurant
a man asleep on a sofa

explain.zh: 聽到的是「飛機」，A 是天上的飛機。
explain.en: You hear 飞机, plane: A.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「杯子」，B 是有把手的杯子；椅子、桌子的音很像，要聽清楚。
explain.en: You hear 杯子, cup: B. 椅子 and 桌子 sound alike — listen closely.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「電視」，C 是電視機；「電話」只差一個字。
explain.en: You hear 电视, television: C. 电话 (telephone) differs by one syllable.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「看書」，B 是坐在長椅上看書的女孩。
explain.en: You hear 看书, reading: B is the girl reading on the bench.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「冷」，A 是在雪裡發抖的男人。
explain.en: You hear 冷, cold: A is the man shivering in the snow.

explain.zh: 問「哪國人」，回答國籍：「我是中國人。」
explain.en: She asks your nationality: "I'm Chinese."

explain.zh: 問「多少錢」，回答價錢：「五塊錢。」
explain.en: He asks the price: "Five kuai."

explain.zh: 問「去哪兒」，回答地方：「我去醫院。」；「明天上午」是時間。
explain.en: She asks where: "To the hospital." 明天上午 would say when.

explain.zh: 用「會」問，就用「會／不會」回答：「我不會。」
explain.en: Asked with 会, you answer with 会 / 不会: "I can't."

lines.en: What time are you going home?

explain.zh: 問「幾點」，回答時間：「下午六點。」
explain.en: She asks what time: "Six in the afternoon."

lines.en: Excuse me, where is the hospital?

explain.zh: 在路上問醫院在哪裡，老先生指給她看：B。
explain.en: Asking the way on the street; the old man points: B.

explain.zh: 問價錢、付錢，是在商店：A。
explain.en: Asking the price and paying at a shop: A.

lines.en: It's cold today — where's your coat?

explain.zh: 媽媽說今天冷、問衣服在哪裡：門口拿衣服給孩子的媽媽，D。
explain.en: Mum says it's cold and asks about the coat: D.

lines.en: OK, there aren't many people here.

explain.zh: 兩個人要在這裡看書：圖書館裡的兩個學生，C。
explain.en: Two people decide to read here: the students at the library table, C.

lines.en: What would you like to eat?

explain.zh: 在飯店點菜：E。F（在沙發上睡覺）是多出來的。
explain.en: Ordering at a restaurant: E. F is the spare picture.

lines.s: 我今天很忙，不能和你去看电影了。
lines.zh: 我今天很忙，不能跟你去看電影了。
lines.en: I'm busy today, so I can't go to the film with you.

explain.zh: 「我今天很忙」，所以不能去看電影。
explain.en: "I'm busy today", so he can't go to the film.

lines.s: 我住在北京，我家有四个人。
lines.zh: 我住在北京，我家有四個人。
lines.en: I live in Beijing; there are four people in my family.

q.en: How many people are in her family?

explain.zh: 「我家有四個人」。
explain.en: "There are four people in my family."

lines.s: 这本书是我同学的，不是我的。
lines.zh: 這本書是我同學的，不是我的。
lines.en: This book is my classmate's, not mine.

explain.zh: 「這本書是我同學的，不是我的」。
explain.en: "This book is my classmate's, not mine."

lines.s: 我喜欢吃米饭，我儿子喜欢吃水果。
lines.zh: 我喜歡吃米飯，我兒子喜歡吃水果。
lines.en: I like rice; my son likes fruit.

q.en: What does her son like to eat?

explain.zh: 喜歡米飯的是她，「我兒子喜歡吃水果」。
explain.en: She likes rice; "my son likes fruit".

lines.s: 现在十二点了，我们去吃饭吧。
lines.zh: 現在十二點了，我們去吃飯吧。
lines.en: It's twelve o'clock now — let's go and eat.

explain.zh: 「現在十二點了」。
explain.en: "It's twelve o'clock now."

a family sitting down to dinner at home
a man with a suitcase walking out of an airport
a doctor talking to an old man in a clinic

explain.zh: 聽到的是「狗」，B 是咬著球的狗。
explain.en: You hear 狗, dog: B.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「開車」，A 是在開車的男人。
explain.en: You hear 开车, to drive: A.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「醫院」，C 是有紅十字的醫院。
explain.en: You hear 医院, hospital: C, with the red cross.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「喝茶」，B 是一起喝茶的兩個朋友。
explain.en: You hear 喝茶, drinking tea: B.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「熱」，C 是在大太陽下流汗的男人。
explain.en: You hear 热, hot: C is the man sweating in the sun.

explain.zh: 問「認識嗎」，回答「認識，他是我同學。」
explain.en: He asks if you know him: "Yes, he's my classmate."

lines.en: How many students does your school have?

explain.zh: 問「多少」，回答數量：「三千多個。」
explain.en: She asks how many: "Over three thousand."

explain.zh: 問「昨天」做了什麼，回答「我在家看書了。」
explain.en: He asks about yesterday: "I stayed home and read."

explain.zh: 問「喜歡嗎」，回答「很喜歡。」
explain.en: She asks if you like it: "Very much."

explain.zh: 問「幾點」，回答時間：「九點。」
explain.en: He asks the time: "Nine o'clock."

lines.en: Teacher, how do you write this character?
Look — I'll write it for you.

explain.zh: 學生問字怎麼寫，老師寫在黑板上：A。
explain.en: A student asks how to write a character; the teacher writes it on the board: A.

explain.zh: 在書店問書的價錢：B。
explain.en: Asking the price of a book in a bookshop: B.

lines.en: Hello, it's me — are you coming tomorrow?

explain.zh: 「喂」是講電話：在房間打電話的女孩，C。
explain.en: 喂 — a phone call: the girl on the phone, C.

lines.en: I'm ill; I don't feel like eating.

explain.zh: 醫生問「你怎麼了？」，病人說「我病了」：看醫生，F。
explain.en: The doctor asks what's wrong; the patient is ill: F.

explain.zh: 「飯做好了，來吃吧」：在家吃晚飯，D。E（下飛機）是多出來的。
explain.en: "Dinner's ready": a family dinner at home, D. E is the spare picture.

lines.s: 我女儿在医院工作，她是医生。
lines.zh: 我女兒在醫院工作，她是醫生。
lines.en: My daughter works at a hospital; she's a doctor.

explain.zh: 「她是醫生」。
explain.en: "She's a doctor."

lines.s: 今天是星期三，明天我去北京。
lines.zh: 今天是星期三，明天我去北京。
lines.en: Today is Wednesday; tomorrow I'm going to Beijing.

q.en: Which day is he going to Beijing?

explain.zh: 今天星期三，「明天」去北京：星期四。
explain.en: Today is Wednesday and he goes "tomorrow": Thursday.

lines.s: 这件衣服太大了，我想要小一点儿的。
lines.zh: 這件衣服太大了，我想要小一點的。
lines.en: This one's too big; I'd like a smaller one.

q.en: What's this item of clothing like?

explain.zh: 「這件衣服太大了」，她想要小一點的。
explain.en: "This one's too big" — she wants a smaller one.

lines.s: 我会说汉语，也会写一点儿汉字。
lines.zh: 我會說漢語，也會寫一點漢字。
lines.en: I can speak Chinese and write a few characters too.

explain.zh: 「我會說漢語」。
explain.en: "I can speak Chinese."

lines.s: 下午我和朋友去商店买东西。
lines.zh: 下午我和朋友去商店買東西。
lines.en: This afternoon my friend and I are going shopping.

q.en: Where is she going this afternoon?

explain.zh: 「去商店買東西」。
explain.en: "…going to the shop to buy things."

explain.zh: 聽到的是「米飯」，A 是一碗白飯。
explain.en: You hear 米饭, rice: A.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「女兒」，B 是抱著女兒的媽媽。
explain.en: You hear 女儿, daughter: B.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「寫字」，C 是用毛筆寫字的男人。
explain.en: You hear 写字, writing: C.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「出租車」（計程車），B。
explain.en: You hear 出租车, taxi: B.

explain.zh: 聽到的是「椅子」，A。
explain.en: You hear 椅子, chair: A.

explain.zh: 問工作，回答「他是醫生。」
explain.en: She asks his job: "He's a doctor."

explain.zh: 問「在哪兒」，回答地方：「在桌子上。」
explain.en: He asks where: "On the table."

explain.zh: 問「幾歲」，回答「我七歲了。」
explain.en: She asks your age: "I'm seven."

lines.en: Are you coming to my place tomorrow?

explain.zh: 邀請明天來家裡，回答「好的，我明天去。」
explain.en: An invitation for tomorrow: "Sure, I'll come tomorrow."

lines.en: What would you like to buy?

explain.zh: 問想「買」什麼，回答「我想買一本書。」
explain.en: She asks what you want to buy: "A book."

explain.zh: 第一次見面打招呼：A。
explain.en: Meeting for the first time: A.

lines.en: Dad, I can't write this character.

explain.zh: 女兒請爸爸教她寫字：B。
explain.en: The daughter asks her father for help writing: B.

explain.zh: 孩子問什麼時候吃飯，媽媽正在做飯：C。
explain.en: The boy asks when dinner is; Mum is cooking: C.

explain.zh: 在市場問蘋果的價錢：D。
explain.en: Asking the price of apples at a stall: D.

lines.en: That's all right — have a seat.

explain.zh: 「我來晚了」：上課遲到的學生，F。E（等公車）是多出來的。
explain.en: "I'm late": the student hurrying into class, F. E is the spare picture.

lines.s: 我今天不去学校，我病了。
lines.zh: 我今天不去學校，我生病了。
lines.en: I'm not going to school today; I'm ill.

explain.zh: 「我病了」，所以今天不去學校。
explain.en: "I'm ill", so she isn't going to school.

lines.s: 我家在北京，我在上海工作。
lines.zh: 我家在北京，我在上海工作。
lines.en: My home is in Beijing; I work in Shanghai.

explain.zh: 家在北京，「我在上海工作」。
explain.en: His home is in Beijing; "I work in Shanghai".

lines.s: 这是我的三个朋友，他们都是日本人。
lines.zh: 這是我的三個朋友，他們都是日本人。
lines.en: These are my three friends; they're all Japanese.

explain.zh: 「他們都是日本人」。
explain.en: "They're all Japanese."

lines.s: 我下午三点去医院看我妈妈。
lines.zh: 我下午三點去醫院看我媽媽。
lines.en: At three this afternoon I'm going to the hospital to see my mum.

q.en: What time is he going to the hospital?

explain.zh: 「我下午三點去醫院」。
explain.en: "At three this afternoon I'm going to the hospital."

lines.s: 今天天气太热了，我们去喝点儿茶吧。
lines.zh: 今天天氣太熱了，我們去喝點茶吧。
lines.en: It's too hot today — let's go and have some tea.

explain.zh: 「今天天氣太熱了」。
explain.en: "It's too hot today."
